levels.surface: عثمان ابن محمد ابن أبي شيبة

notes: the field has two routes separated by «|»: each is its own group, and both write their own names, so the tail is null; «جدتي» and «جدي» are relations written before a name, so the name alone is the surface (rule 7); «سمعته أنا» is the compiler's own voice and is not written; the matn «سمعت جدي عبيدة ... يقول» makes عبيدة ابن عمرو الكلابي the last link, and the same occurrence serves both routes
